title: Sharpened Swords
description: A simple texture pack that makes every sword look sharper and cleaner while keeping the vanilla style. Hope you like it!
body: A **simple** texture pack that makes every sword look _sharper_ and _cleaner_ while keeping the **vanilla** style. The textures are redesigned with improved details and refined edges, creating a polished look that feels natural and fits perfectly within Minecraft's original aesthetic.
